title: Audit documented LR-FHSS receiver candidates
description:
Audit documented receivers before proposing new SDR or silicon work. Start with the publicly readable jumanamirza/LR-FHSS-receiver MATLAB candidate, reverify and pin its actual revision, entry points, tools, supported DRs, assumed timing/profile inputs and published capture claims.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Public read-only inspection only. Do not execute restricted code, accept terms, install paid tools or interpret licensing permissibility. lrfhss.09 is the human access/reuse gate before such use; optional external actions remain separately permission-gated.
acceptance_criteria: Distinguish offline decoder, real-time receiver and simulation. Record the stated small-payload DR8/DR9 evidence scope without extrapolation, along with missing code/data/tool facts and usage restrictions. Produce a reproducible candidate assessment or no-go, not a claim that the receiver has been run.
